decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records that the champagne metallic finish supplies elevation, light, refinement, and emotional richness; no additional update or removal is required.
The Hero V state already requires a purposeful rather than motion-dominated right arm and a timeless, inevitable, confident silhouette; the source adds no necessary change to those attributes.
The source discusses the Hero V silhouette and material finish but does not change the second V's role or derivation from the Hero V.
The source does not change complete-wordmark rhythm, kerning, or the hierarchy of the remaining letters.
The source does not change the wordmark-led identity model, the absence of a separate icon, or the opening V's standalone brand-asset role.
The source does not change the É accent's derivation, shared geometry, or form.
The source concerns the Hero V silhouette and finish hierarchy, not the construction or visual language of the remaining proprietary letterforms.
A purposeful rise does not necessarily alter the established structural, deliberate, and non-decorative terminal treatment.
